messages:
Li (Logistics): Heads up — OrionCloud just flagged a partial manifest at the EU crossdock. Truck weight limit + customs pallet hold => they're splitting our reserved rack shipment into two deliveries next week.
Sarah (Partnerships): how big a split? does it touch dedicated commits or just marketplace SKUs?
Li (Logistics): ~12 racks delayed to week+2, 8 arriving on original eta. Affected reservation ids: R-4591, R-4592. Orion says they can split by strength of commitment: dedicated customers first. No hard ETA for remainder yet.
Noah (Product): This will impact the APAC private rollout? Our SI partner is expecting full rack on 4/18 for on-prem testing.
Ben (Ops): cc @Noah — if we only get partial, we should prioritize SI test racks. Can we ask Orion to reassign one of the dedicated racks to APAC test pool? (they seemed open to swaps)
Li (Logistics): asked them. They replied: 'can offer swap if we re-route one EU rack to APAC via air, extra cost + customs clearance.' Waiting numbers.
Sarah (Partnerships): Important for the joint announcement timeline. If APAC test slips, we should delay co-announcement or scope to hosted/Dedicated only. @Gaia, any contractual risk if we delay messaging?
Gaia (Legal): delay is safe from a contract POV. Avoid promising dates. If customer-facing comms reference specific hardware arrival, add caveat.
Noah (Product): For rollout plan — let's decouple SI announcement from marketplace listing until we confirm final rack dates. Can the Console team toggle region in the launch playbook? 
Ben (Ops): yes, but we need a reservation-adjust command for quick reassigns. Drafted a one-off script:
```
redwood-reserve adjust --partner orioncloud --from-region eu-west --to-region apac-sg --qty 1 --reservation R-4592
```
Li (Logistics): confirmed that command will work with ops role. I'll hold until we get the airfreight quote.
Sarah (Partnerships): action items: 1) Li to get air cost + customs timeline by EOD; 2) Ben to prepare fallback playbook toggles for announcement; 3) Noah to update SI integration timeline; 4) Gaia to draft comms caveat. 
Ben (Ops): noted. tagging ops-runner for automation (ops-runner): :eyes:
ops-runner: automation workflow created for reservation reassign. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/reservation-reassign
Li (Logistics): I'll post final ETA update when I have the quote. thanks all.
